edges.notes: fetchChannels(): axios.get("http://localhost:5000/api/channels", { params: { userId } }); literal host = SyncUpBackend/server.js PORT fallback 5000 (SyncUpBackend/.env sets no PORT). server.js mounts channelRoutes at /api/channels; router.get('/'). Query params dropped

fetchMessages() polled every 5 s: axios.get(`http://localhost:5000/api/channels/${selectedChannel}/messages`); router.get('/:channelId/messages') under the /api/channels mount (not junk/messageRoutes.js, whose /api/messages mount is commented out). The identical request in the commented-out block at line 93 isn't code, so not labeled

fetchInvitations(): axios.get("http://localhost:5000/api/channels/invitations", { params: { email } }); router.get("/invitations") under /api/channels. The earlier GET '/:channelId/messages' needs two segments, so it can't take this path. Query dropped
handleAcceptInvite(): axios.put(`http://localhost:5000/api/channels/invitations/${invitationId}/accept`, {}); router.put("/invitations/:invitationId/accept") under /api/channels

handleDeclineInvite(): axios.delete(`http://localhost:5000/api/channels/invitations/${invitationId}/decline`), but the server registers that path only for PUT (channelRoutes.js line 82, router.put("/invitations/:invitationId/decline")); no DELETE route matches, so Express answers 404
handleCreateChannel(): axios.post("http://localhost:5000/api/channels", { name, inviteEmails }); router.post('/') under /api/channels
handleSendMessage(): axios.post(`http://localhost:5000/api/channels/${selectedChannel}/messages`, { message }); router.post('/:channelId/messages', authenticate, postMessage) under /api/channels
handleInviteUsers(): axios.post(`http://localhost:5000/api/channels/${selectedChannel}/invite`, { invitedUserEmail }); router.post("/:channelId/invite") under /api/channels
handleSubmit(): axios.post('http://localhost:5000/api/auth/signin', formData); server.js mounts authRoutes at /api/auth; router.post('/signin')
handleRequestOtp(): axios.post("http://localhost:5000/api/auth/register-otp", { email }); router.post('/register-otp') under /api/auth
handleSubmit(): axios.post("http://localhost:5000/api/auth/register", formData); router.post('/register') under /api/auth

axios (line 130) .post("http://localhost:3000/workspaces/coworkers", { workspaceId }) chained on line 131. Port 3000 is Update/Server (app.js: server.listen(3000)); SyncUpBackend listens on 5000. Update/Server/server.js mounts workspaceRouter at /workspaces; workspaceRouter.post("/coworkers")
axios (line 14) .post("http://localhost:3000/channels/channels", { workspaceId }) chained on line 15; Update/Server on port 3000 mounts channelRouter at /channels; channelRouter.post("/channels")
axios (line 19) .get("http://localhost:3000/workspaces") chained on line 20; workspaceRouter.get("/") under the /workspaces mount of Update/Server (port 3000)
nested in the workspaces request's .then: axios (line 25) .get("http://localhost:3000/channels") chained on line 26; channelRouter.get("/") under /channels

nested in the channels request's .then: axios (line 33) .post("http://localhost:3000/messages", { channels }) chained on line 34; Update/Server/server.js mounts messageRouter at /messages; messageRouter.post("/")
handleCreateWorkspace(): axios.post("http://localhost:3000/auth/signup", { email, name, workspace }); Update/Server mounts authRouter at /auth; authRouter.post("/signup")
axios.post("http://localhost:3000/auth", { email }); authRouter.post("/") under the /auth mount
same request as Signin.jsx: axios.post("http://localhost:3000/auth", { email }); authRouter.post("/") under /auth
performVerification(): axios.post("http://localhost:3000/auth/verify-otp", { email, code }); authRouter.post("/verify-otp") under /auth
